SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments WHERE trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' )

SELECT t.name, COALESCE(t.specialty, '전문 분야 미등록') AS specialty, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.member_id) AS assigned_member_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wr.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN wr.id END) AS active_routine_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ws.started_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY) THEN ws.id END) AS weekly_workout_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ws.started_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN ws.member_id END) AS members_with_recent_workout_count FROM trainers t LEFT JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.trainer_id = t.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.member_id = ta.member_id AND wr.trainer_id = t.id LEFT JOIN workout_sessions ws ON ws.member_id = ta.member_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.specialty

SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, COALESCE((SELECT wr.title FROM workout_routines wr WHERE wr.member_id = m.id AND wr.trainer_id = t.id AND wr.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY wr.start_date DESC, wr.id DESC LIMIT 1), '활성 루틴 없음') AS routine_title, MAX(ws.started_at) AS last_workout_at FROM trainers t JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.trainer_id = t.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN members m ON m.id = ta.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN workout_sessions ws ON ws.member_id = m.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, t.id ORDER BY last_workout_at DESC, m.name
SELECT name, phone, specialty FROM trainers WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE trainers SET name = #{form.name}, phone = #{form.phone}, specialty = #{form.specialty}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name, m.phone, u.email, m.birth_date, m.gender, COALESCE((SELECT mp.name FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = m.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm.end_date LIMIT 1), '활성 회원권 없음') AS active_membership, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(mm.remaining_pt_sessions) FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = m.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mp.product_type IN ('PT', 'COMBINED')), 0) AS remaining_pt_sessions FROM trainers t JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.trainer_id = t.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN members m ON m.id = ta.member_id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND m.id = #{memberId}
